sources.title: Sweaterdog/GRaPE-1.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ⚡ Parameter Efficiency GRaPE 1.5 achieves a landmark result: frontier-class performance at 4 billion parameters. GRaPE 1.5 delivers 97-99% of frontier model performance while using 99.7% fewer parameters than the leading closed-source models. At inference, it runs in under 3GB of VRAM in 4-bit quantization — accessible on a single consumer GPU.
